scope.summary: Bind BodyKit to the PromotionGate per Section 13.27: body and recipe promotion route exclusively through the gate with MeshComparator-class equivalence between the sandbox result and the promoted artifact, CPROM idempotency, and structural no-self-approval — interactive/exploratory receipts rejected as promotion evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Body and recipe promotion have exactly one path — through PromotionGate; a test proves no alternative write reaches the promoted state (API, storage glue, and job lanes all route through the gate).

Promotion runs MeshComparator-class equivalence between the validated sandbox body and the artifact being promoted (hash/topology/delta equality within the comparator's policy); mismatch rejects with a typed diff.
CPROM idempotency: re-promoting identical content is a no-op returning the original promotion receipt; content drift under the same id is rejected, not silently repromoted.

No self-approval: the session that authored a draft cannot supply its own validation verdict for promotion (attribution check); receipts flagged interactive/exploratory (MT-462 pattern) are rejected as promotion evidence.
All promotion attempts (pass and fail) emit ledger events with full attribution.
scope.risk_if_missed: Model-authored junk becomes authority through a side door, or duplicate promotions corrupt lineage — the two failure modes the kernel's whole sandbox->validate->promote architecture exists to prevent.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
